Criteria.TestCondition: All functionality can be accessed and executed using only the keyboard.
Criteria.TesterComment: Some things on this page work with a mouse but not with the keyboard, so keyboard users cannot use them. "#demo-reel-row" works with a mouse but can't be reached with the keyboard, and nothing else on the page does the same thing (Big play button starts the demo reel. No reached element plays it. The Portfolio link goes to another page, so it doesn't count.). If you disagree, tell your assistant. We looked for: things a mouse can click that the keyboard never reaches, including inside frames; menus that open when the mouse rests on them; custom controls that ignore Enter and Space; and tooltips with information found nowhere else. Results are for the browser used (version 153.0.8010.12).
